title: Audit allowlist — confirmed polysemy + cluster-acceptable (wyrd-kutx batch 2D + cross-sibling)
notes: Operator-maintained allowlist for lexicon audit-semantic-coherence. Two event types ride in this file: known_polysemy filters intra-entry-suspects.csv (one etymon with two glosses the cosine audit sees as distant but the operator has confirmed are related senses of one word); known_cluster_acceptable filters cross-sibling-suspects.csv (two etymons that legitimately share a bundle surface form, like OE 'ost' 'knot in a tree' and OF 'ost' 'army' both contributing to '-ost-' toponyms). Add to this file when reviewing a new audit run surfaces a false-positive that future runs would re-flag.
